title: Simple Challenge Roulette
description: Challenge Roulette — spin the roulette to get a random target item and a gameplay modifier, then complete the challenge as fast as you can! Winning unlocks harder items and modifiers.
body:
Challenge Roulette is a Minecraft mod that adds a unique speedrun-like challenge system. Spin the item roulette to get your target, spin the modifier roulette to get your handicap, and race against the clock!

How to Play
1. Start a new world — the challenge menu will appear automatically.
2. Spin the Item Roulette to get your target item.
3. Spin the Modifier Roulette to get a gameplay restriction (e.g., No Sprint, No Armor, Only Tools, etc.).
4. Complete the challenge by obtaining the target item as fast as possible while playing under the modifier's rules.
5. Your win count unlocks harder items and more extreme modifiers over time.

Features
- Item Roulette — randomly selects a target block or item from multiple tiers.
- Modifier Roulette — applies random gameplay restrictions to make every run unique.
- Progression System — wins unlock harder and more interesting items and modifiers.
- Timer — track your time and compete against yourself.


#Note
To start a completely new challenge, return to the main menu and create a new world.
